correctness.rationale: Direct signed-basis expansion proves lambda(S)=234-108k+36*C(k,2)-8*C(k,3)+8*t(S), with t counting collinear triples in S. It follows symbolically that lambda(S)=2 mod4, ruling out zeros. For the complete finite histogram, verify.py independently constructs 234 noncollinear bases by F_3 determinants, takes their exact 8192-entry Walsh transform, and compares it with line-intersection evaluations at every frequency; exact signed histogram, 7 refined shells, witness gap 2, Parseval and symmetries were checked from actual files.
